title: AwesomeCloud IAM Roles Test - SYSTEM1234 System Engineer Role
description: Test AwesomeCloud IAM Roles for least privilege design and implementation.
remarks:
The assessor's security automation platform analyzed all roles specific to the SYSTEM1234 Product Team, not those managed by the Office of Information Technology. The `IFA-SYSTEM1234-SystemEngineer` role in their respective AwesomeCloud account permitted use of the following high-risk actions.

* awesomecloud:auditlog:DeleteAccountAuditLog
* awesomecloud:secmon:AdministerConfigurations


Both of these actions are overly permissive and not appropriate for the business function of the staff member assigned this role.
